summary: _ansible_no_log (bool) is True when a task or play sets no_log; AnsibleModule.log respects it automatically, and custom loggers should check AnsibleModule.no_log. Argument spec no_log is separate.
questions: How does my module know a task set no_log?
Is task-level no_log the same as no_log in the argument_spec?

answer_card.title: _ansible_no_log
answer_card.answer_md: Type `bool`. `True` when the task or play sets `no_log`. `AnsibleModule.log` honors it automatically; if you log yourself, check `module.no_log`. `no_log` in an `argument_spec` is a different mechanism.
